acceptanceCriteria: Owner-reviewed exact public/private path, history/ref and destination scope is retained with rollback before any destructive or outward move.
Internal specs and accepted planning records are preserved in the approved private authority; public consumer, license, build and API material remains usable without private access.
Public source build and required verification work without the private repository; private authority checks remain explicitly enforced in the development workflow.
Immutable evidence, preregistration and candidate qualification are rebound or retain explicit limitations after the split; no unsupported historical erasure or old receipt equivalence is claimed.
body: Owner directly requested in Prepare Corvint v1 final qualification on 2026-09-29: move all specs to their own private repository, keeping the public repository useful to consumers rather than exposing planning and thought process. Required before final candidate freeze. Preserve consumer installation, usage, API, licensing, source-build and support documentation. Prepared path/dependency inventory and combined history proposal must determine private destination/access, forward-only versus historical removal and exact refs/assets. Do not infer authorization for deleting published tags or rewriting history from this scope request. Existing contributor-only rewrite proposal is superseded pending combined disposition. Rebind immutable evidence and release qualification after the approved split; do not rewrite historical receipts or weaken required gates. Scratch proposal owned by qualification lane; sole queue and integration owner remains root.
title: 1.0: move internal specifications and planning to private authority
